purpose: future experiments only; does not retroactively certify historical embeddings
text_composition: NFKC+casefold each field; collapse whitespace; join nonempty fullName,bio,location with one ASCII space; all empty -> [empty]

pair_feature.name: bert_cos
pair_feature.formula: dot product of L2-normalized endpoint profile embeddings

alignment.embedding_id_order: exactly the approved snapshot profile_row_id order
alignment.pair_key: explicit profile_row_id_a/profile_row_id_b; never row-position or hash inversion

feature_columns: FEATURE17 ordered columns followed by exactly one bert_cos column
human_approval: not asserted; candidate snapshot and data-use approval remain separate
